dialogue.origin: こんにちは、どうぞ宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.content: Hello. Thank you for coming, and I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.content: Thank you. I look forward to our session as well.

dialogue.origin: 時間前ですが、どういたしましょうか
dialogue.content: We’re a little early—how would you like to proceed?

dialogue.origin: 早めに始めてもいいと思います
dialogue.content: I think it’s fine to start early.

dialogue.origin: では、宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.content: Alright then, let’s begin.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今日は、どのようなご相談でしょうか？年齢と性別など、教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.content: So, what would you like to discuss today? Could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 47歳、女性です
dialogue.content: I'm a 47-year-old woman.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.origin: 夜に眠れないんです
dialogue.content: I can’t sleep at night.

dialogue.origin: 夜ねむれないのですね
dialogue.content: So you’re having trouble sleeping at night.

dialogue.origin: はいなかなか寝付けなくて薬を飲むのですが、しばらくすると目が覚めていて
dialogue.content: Yes. I have a hard time falling asleep, so I take medication, but after a while I just wake up again.

dialogue.origin: ご家族はいらっしゃいますか
dialogue.content: Do you have any family?

dialogue.origin: 今は一人で暮らしています
dialogue.content: I'm living alone right now.

dialogue.origin: 今は、一人なんですね
dialogue.content: So you’re living on your own at the moment.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: いつぐらいからねむれなくなっているんですか
dialogue.content: About how long have you been having trouble sleeping?

dialogue.origin: この2年ほどですかね
dialogue.content: For about the last two years, I'd say.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 何か少し考えたりしていることがありますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything that's been on your mind?

dialogue.origin: 娘のこととか、暮らしのこととか、これからのこととか、いろんなことが頭の中に渦巻いていて、考え出すと止まらなくなります
dialogue.content: Things about my daughter, my daily life, my future... all sorts of things are swirling in my head, and once I start thinking, I can't stop.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、これから一緒に考えていきましょう。眠れないことで、何か対応策は考えていますか
dialogue.content: Mm-hm, let's work through this together. Regarding your trouble sleeping, have you considered any coping strategies?

dialogue.origin: 薬を飲んでも効かないので、どうしたものかと
dialogue.content: Even with medication it doesn’t help, so I’m at a loss about what to do.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね！娘さんはおいくつですか。
dialogue.content: I see. How old is your daughter?

dialogue.origin: 18歳になります
dialogue.content: She'll be 18.

dialogue.origin: 2年前までは一緒に住んでいました
dialogue.content: We lived together until two years ago.

dialogue.origin: 高校生ですか。何か心配事があるのですか？
dialogue.content: Is she in high school? Is there something you’re worried about?

dialogue.origin: 12年前に離婚してから、10年間ずっと一人で育ててきたのですが、2年前にぶつかって、私が自殺未遂をしてから、元夫に引き取られて絶縁状態です
dialogue.content: After my divorce 12 years ago, I raised her by myself for 10 years. But two years ago, we had a major conflict, and after I attempted suicide, my ex-husband took her in, and we've been estranged ever since.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そうなんですね
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm, I see.

dialogue.origin: 何のために10年間頑張って育ててきたのか
dialogue.content: What was the point of working so hard to raise her for those 10 years?

dialogue.origin: そう思うと悲しくて
dialogue.content: Thinking about that makes me so sad.

dialogue.origin: 子育てを一生懸命にされて来たんですもの、心配ですよね、側にいない分
dialogue.content: You devoted yourself to raising her, so it’s only natural to worry, especially since she’s not by your side now.

dialogue.origin: 会いたいですよね
dialogue.content: You want to see her, don’t you?

dialogue.origin: はい会いたいです
dialogue.content: Yes, I do want to see her.

dialogue.origin: 娘さんは住まいは、遠く何ですか
dialogue.content: Does your daughter live far away?

dialogue.origin: でも娘には嫌われてしまって会うことができません
dialogue.content: But my daughter hates me, so I can't see her.

dialogue.origin: それほど遠くない、別の市にすんでいます
dialogue.content: She lives in a different city, not too far away.

dialogue.origin: 何かしこりがあるのですね、どんな事で娘さんと、ぶつかったのですか
dialogue.content: There seems to be some unresolved tension. What was the conflict with your daughter about?

dialogue.origin: 私が悪いんです、過干渉というか、娘をしばっていたというか私にとっては娘しかいなかったので
dialogue.content: It's my fault. I was overbearing... I guess I was smothering her. It's just that she was all I had.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: でも、その娘に嫌われてしまったら、もう生きる望みが失われると思って自殺未遂をしてしまったのです
dialogue.content: But I thought that if she came to hate me, I would lose my will to live, and that's why I attempted suicide.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、娘さんも、お母さんに認めてもらいたくて、頑張っていたのでしょう
dialogue.content: Mm-hm. Your daughter was probably also trying her best, wanting to get your approval.

dialogue.origin: それがいけなかったそんな親に任せてはおけないと、夫の元に引き取られてしまったのです
dialogue.content: That was the problem. They decided she couldn't be left with a parent like me, so she was taken in by my ex-husband.

dialogue.origin: 娘は私から離れて自由になりたかったのかもしれません
dialogue.content: My daughter may have wanted to get away from me and be free.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、どんなぶつかりかたをしてしまったのですか
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm, what kind of conflict was it?

dialogue.origin: 進路のこととか、いろいろですね
dialogue.content: Her future career path, and various other things.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 寂しくて生きているのが辛いです
dialogue.content: I'm so lonely, it's painful to be alive.

dialogue.origin: 今の私には何にもありませんただ暮らしに汲々としているだけで、未来も見通せないし
dialogue.content: I have nothing now. I'm just struggling to make ends meet, and I can't see a future for myself.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、娘さんも、たまにはお母さんに会いたいとおもいときもありますよね。だって、世界でたった一人のお母さんですもね
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm. I'm sure there are times your daughter wants to see you, too. After all, you're the only mother she has in the world.

dialogue.origin: 生きている意味なんてあるんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is there any meaning to my life?

dialogue.origin: そんなことは無いと思います向こうから連絡してきたことなんて一度もありません
dialogue.content: I don’t think so. She’s never once reached out to me.

dialogue.origin: まだ連絡がないのですね。ご主人とも、連絡はとっていないのですか。
dialogue.content: So there's been no contact yet. Are you not in touch with your ex-husband either?

dialogue.origin: 今、娘がコンビニでアルバイトをしていることは知っています
dialogue.content: I know that my daughter is working part-time at a convenience store right now.

dialogue.origin: 実は、ときどきそれを遠くから眺めにいくのです
dialogue.content: The truth is, I sometimes go to watch her from a distance.

dialogue.origin: 気付かれないようにこっそりと
dialogue.content: Secretly, so she doesn’t notice me.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。姿がみれるたけても、安心ですね！会話がでくるといいですね。
dialogue.content: I see. Even just seeing her must give you some peace of mind. It would be wonderful if you could talk with her someday.

dialogue.origin: 話をするのはとても無理ですでも、娘が元気に働いている姿を見ると嬉しくて
dialogue.content: Talking to her is out of the question. But seeing her working so energetically makes me happy.

dialogue.origin: 娘さんと仲直り出来ると、一つ安心しますよね。
dialogue.content: If you could reconcile with your daughter, that would be a great relief, wouldn't it?

dialogue.origin: あれだけ激しくぶつかってしまうと、そう簡単にはいかないと思います
dialogue.content: After clashing so intensely, I don’t think it will be that easy.

dialogue.origin: 娘さんの頑張っているすがたか、あすの活力になると、いいですね
dialogue.content: It would be wonderful if seeing your daughter working so hard could give you strength for tomorrow.

dialogue.origin: 今の私にはそれくらいしかないのですが、来年には娘も就職するので、コンビニで姿を見ることもできなくなってしまいます
dialogue.content: That's about all I have right now, but she'll be getting a full-time job next year, so I won't be able to see her at the convenience store anymore.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そうですね！就職では、大人の仲間入りで、頼もしくもありますね。時間がたち、むすめさんも、結婚をして、母親になったとき、初めてお母さんのありがたみがわかりますよ。きっと、後もう一つの心配事は、暮らしとのことですが、
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right. By getting a job, she's joining the world of adults, which is very admirable. As time goes by, when your daughter gets married and becomes a mother herself, she'll understand for the first time how much she appreciates you. I'm sure of it. Now, about your other concern, your living situation...

dialogue.origin: いつの日か解り合える日がくつといいのですが
dialogue.content: I hope the day will come when we can understand each other.

dialogue.origin: はい、大丈夫です必ずきますとも
dialogue.content: Yes, it will be alright. That day will definitely come.

dialogue.origin: そうですねそれを願うしかないですね
dialogue.content: You’re right. All I can do is hope for that.

dialogue.origin: はい、私も願っています。
dialogue.content: Yes, I’m hoping for that as well.

dialogue.origin: 暮らしは厳しいです派遣で働いていますが給料が低くて、ぎりぎりの生活です
dialogue.content: My living situation is tough. I work as a temp, but the pay is low, and I'm barely making ends meet.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 将来の年金も少なく当てにはできません
dialogue.content: My future pension will be small, so I can’t count on it.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: だから少ないお金の中から、少しは貯金もしておかなくてはならなくて
dialogue.content: So even with the little money I have, I have to set some aside for savings.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 楽しみに使うよゆうなど全くありません
dialogue.content: There's absolutely no room to spend money on things for enjoyment.

dialogue.origin: 確かに考えただけで、眠れなくなりますね
dialogue.content: Just thinking about all that would certainly keep you up at night.

dialogue.origin: ただ、毎日なんとか暮らしているっていう感じで、未来も見えないんです
dialogue.content: It feels like I’m just barely getting by each day, and I can’t see a future.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 親密に話す相手もいないし、楽しいこともないし、
dialogue.content: I have no one to talk to intimately, and there's nothing enjoyable in my life.

dialogue.origin: それは、辛いですよね。子供さんは、御一人ですか
dialogue.content: That must be very difficult. Is your daughter your only child?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 体も大事にしないと壊れてしまいます。ぐっすりと睡眠がとれると、体も少しずつは楽なんですが
dialogue.content: You have to take care of your body, or it will break down. If you could get a good night's sleep, your body would start to feel a little better, bit by bit.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですけれどね
dialogue.content: I know, but…

dialogue.origin: 今まで、相談にのって、下さるかたは、いなかったのですか
dialogue.content: Until now, have you not had anyone you could talk to for advice?

dialogue.origin: 親しい友人はいませんでした両親も早くに他界し、仲が良かった弟まで7年前に自殺してしまって、あとは相談できるような人はいませんでした
dialogue.content: I didn’t have any close friends. My parents passed away early, and even my brother, who I was close to, died by suicide seven years ago. After that, there was no one I could really turn to.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、生活で、やりくりしながら頑張っていることは、私には真似の出来ないことです。
dialogue.content: I see... The way you're managing to persevere and get by is something I can only admire.

dialogue.origin: これからの事は、自分が楽しみを見つけて、生活が大変ななかにも、希望をみつけて、いると、そのうち、嬢さんからも、嬉しいしらせが、きっと届きます。今日は、お時間がきてしまいましたので、つぎに、ぐっすり、眠れる提案がありますので、お知らせしますね。また、来て下さいね。
dialogue.content: As for the future, if you can find small joys for yourself and hold onto hope even amid life's difficulties, I’m sure that, in time, you’ll receive happy news from your daughter. Our time is up for today, but at our next session, I have some suggestions that may help you sleep more soundly. Please come again.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 今日は、此で大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Will that be all for today?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: また宜しくお願いします
dialogue.content: I look forward to our next session.

dialogue.origin: ては、主任させて頂きます。ありがとうこさいました。また宜しくお願い致します。合掌
dialogue.content: Well then, we’ll conclude here. Thank you very much. I look forward to working with you again. [Gassho]

dialogue.origin: 主任ではなく失礼です
dialogue.content: I apologize, that was a mistake. I meant to type 'end the session'.

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫ですよ
dialogue.content: It’s alright.

dialogue.origin: 失礼いたします
dialogue.content: Goodbye for now.

dialogue.origin: 終了させて頂きます。合掌
dialogue.content: I will bring the session to a close. [Gassho]
